g.title: HR_SESSION
g.text: Session - This entity contains training session.
The identifier of the Course record.
Training plan identifier related to Training Session.
This field contains the concatenation of Session Code and Course Code
The validity start date for an historical situation.
The validity end date for an historical situation.
Option to determine if an employee can self enrol or is subject to approval.
Minumum number of seats for the session.
Maximum number of seats for the session.
Indicates if a waiting list is allowed for the session.
Indicates the deadline policy for completing the course.
Number of days in which to complete the course.
The identifier of instructor evaluation survey.
With this field you can specify the criteria to determine if a course is passed.
This is the minimum score in percentage that determines the course has been passed.
dscription of field training center for entity session
description of field training classroom for entity session

Indicates the minimum required session attendance, expressed as a percentage. If the average of the overall activity attendances is less than this indicator, the whole session will be considered as Not Attended.
Activate this flag to mark this Training resource as required for compulsory training. For example, to renew or take a certification/qualification.
Number of days before the session starts you would like to send an automatic invitation by eMail.
Number of days after the attendance you would like to create the effectiveness evaluation.
Indicates the date and time of creation
Indicates the user who has created it
Indicates the IP address from which it was created
Indicates the date and time of last update operation
Indicates the user who has executed last update
Indicates the IP address from which was executed last update
Indicates how many update was executed since its creation

g.title: HR_COURSE
g.text: Course - This entity contains the catalogue of courses.
The identifier of course type record.
This field enables an additional classification of the Training Type; beyond Classroom, VCR, E-Learning.
The identifier of course category record.
A description of the course and its objectives.
The identifier of visual resource for the banner.
The identifier of self enrolment policy record.
The page of displayed to the learners.
When a company is associated to a course it means that any HR with a Security Filter defined on a different company will not be able to view or manage this course and all related sessions.
Use this field to define the survey to be sent to learners to gather feedback after the course.
Use this field to define the survey to be sent to instructors after the course to gather feedback.
Indicates if attendees can rate this course.
Indicates if social wall is enabled for enrolled people.
The template to be used for the attendance certificate.
Specifies the teaching method for the course.
The identifier of lablur cost option record.
Specify a filter of people for whom this course is designed.
Specify a filter to identify the most suitable instructor.
The identifier of the training centre record.
The identifier of the classroom record.
The identifier of the organizational unit record.
The questionnaire that will be used to assess the effectiveness of the Participant Training.
Activate this flag to mark this Training resource as required for compulsory training. For example, to renew or take a certification/qualification.

g.title: HR_LEARNER
g.text: Learner - This is the entity representing a person enrolled or candidate to a course.
The identifier of the company relationship record.
A reference to a Training Session.
This field contains the code of the learner.
Displays the person's name and the session code.
The reason why a Learner was enrolled on a Session.
This is a note/comment related to the learner.
This is a note to justify, for example, a rejection of the enrolment.
This is the status of the Learner, from a choice of Candidate, Enrolled, In Wait List or Cancelled.
This is the completion status of the Learner.
This is the source who the learner has been proposed as candidated by.
This is the source who the learner hase been enrolled by.
Indicates if the Learning was completed successfully.
Activate this flag to mark this Training resource as required for compulsory training. For example, to renew or take a certification/qualification.
Average score coming from all scored activities.
The date when the person became a candidate for the course.
Indicates the enrol date of learner.
The date and time when the Learner started the activity.
The date and time when the Learner completed the course.
This indicates when the learner was added to waiting list.
The number of absences that a learner took, if applicable.
The unit of measure for total absences.
Identifier of a 5-levels rating scale value.
Indicates the learner's progress in a session.
This is the number of activities completed by a Learner.
This is the average score for all Test/Quiz activities for a given learner.
This field is used to categorise the learner.
This field indicates the type of financing
Indicates if an e-Mail for inviting the Learner has been sent.
Indicates the date and time of creation
